notes: `נָא` is rendered by *now* here, so rule 30's entreaty formula (*I beseech thee*) has nothing to place; the written word is what is aligned.

The supplied *of* in *demand of thee* and *unto* in *declare thou unto me* reach verbal object suffixes carrying no preposition of their own, so both belong to their verbs' units under rule 44's closing paragraph, the suffixes keeping only their pronouns.
